doc.title: Texas Instruments LM340, LM340A and LM7805 Family Datasheet (section 5 Pin Configuration and Functions, 3-Pin TO-220 NDE package) and uA78xx Datasheet
doc.revision: SNOSBT0L (February 2000, Revised September 2016) and SLVS056P (May 1976, Revised January 2015)
doc.pinNumbering: Pins 1-3 follow the 3-Pin TO-220 (NDE / KCS) Pin Functions table: 1 INPUT, 2 GND (COMMON), 3 OUTPUT. The TO-220 metal tab is connected to pin 2 (GND).
doc.notes: Fixed 5 V positive linear regulator, up to 1.5 A output current, DC input up to 35 V (7.5-20 V recommended for line regulation). Typical application uses a 0.22 uF or 0.33 uF input capacitor and a 0.1 uF output capacitor to GND.
